TRAINING ZONE: Pick a level. Juno teleports you to its room.
训练区: 选择一个关卡。朱诺会把你传送到它的房间。

TRAINING ZONE: Clear the previous level first
训练区: 先通过前一关

TRAINING ZONE: Welcome to the Training Zone. I am Juno, your guide for six short levels.
训练区: 欢迎来到训练区。我是朱诺，将带你走完六个简短的关卡。

TRAINING ZONE: Nothing in here can hurt you for real, and your save is never touched.
训练区: 这里的一切都不会真正伤到你，你的存档也不会受到影响。

TRAINING ZONE: Level one: get your legs under you. Cross the hall, then jump and dash.
训练区: 第一关：先适应一下身体。穿过大厅，然后跳跃和闪避冲刺。

TRAINING ZONE: Good. You move like you mean it. On to the shooting range.
训练区: 不错，动作很干脆。接下来去射击场。

TRAINING ZONE: Level two: the range. Knock the targets down first.
训练区: 第二关：射击场。先把靶子打倒。

TRAINING ZONE: Then the bots start shooting back. Duck behind crates and dash through their fire.
训练区: 然后机器人会开始还击。躲到箱子后面，或者闪避冲过它们的火力。

TRAINING ZONE: Range cleared. That was real shooting. Quiet work is next.
训练区: 射击场通过。这才叫射击。下一关是无声作业。

TRAINING ZONE: Level three: quiet work. Not every guard needs a fight.
训练区: 第三关：无声作业。不是每个守卫都需要打一场。

TRAINING ZONE: Stay behind them, take them down, tie them up and hide the body.
训练区: 绕到他们身后，放倒、捆好，再把尸体藏起来。

TRAINING ZONE: Clean. Nobody heard a thing. Now the netrunning room.
训练区: 干净利落，没人听到任何动静。接下来是网络入侵室。

TRAINING ZONE: Level four: netrunning. Terminals, RAM and the cyberweapon.
训练区: 第四关：网络入侵。终端、内存和网络武器。

TRAINING ZONE: Every hack costs RAM, and RAM comes back slowly. Spend it where it counts.
训练区: 每次入侵都消耗内存，而内存恢复得很慢。把它用在刀刃上。

TRAINING ZONE: Good. You can fight with a keyboard too. Security is next.
训练区: 很好，你也能用键盘战斗。下一关是安保系统。

TRAINING ZONE: Level five: security. Cameras, locks, alarms and vents.
训练区: 第五关：安保系统。摄像头、门锁、警报和通风管。

TRAINING ZONE: You can shoot a camera, or cut the power at its breaker box.
训练区: 你可以直接击毁摄像头，或者在配电箱处切断电源。

TRAINING ZONE: You are through. One exam is left, and it is a big one.
训练区: 你过关了。只剩最后一场考核，而且是场硬仗。

TRAINING ZONE: The final level: the exam. Meet the Instructor, the combat program of this facility.
训练区: 最后一关：毕业考核。来见见教官，这座设施的战斗程序。

TRAINING ZONE: Override both pylons to drop its shield, then bring it down. You cannot lose here, so give it everything.
训练区: 接管两座电塔来击落它的护盾，然后把它打倒。这里不会真的输，所以全力以赴吧。

TRAINING ZONE: That is the exam. You are a graduate. Step into the green beam when you are ready.
训练区: 考核结束，你毕业了。准备好后就踏入绿色光柱。

TRAINING ZONE: No harm done. Breathe and go again.
训练区: 没事，深呼吸，再来一次。

TRAINING ZONE: Everyone goes down in here. That is what it is for.
训练区: 每个人都会倒下，这里就是为此而设的。

TRAINING ZONE: Shake it off. Use the cover and try once more.
训练区: 别在意，利用掩体再试一次。

TRAINING ZONE: Hold still. I am sending you to the next room.
训练区: 别动，我这就把你送到下一个房间。
